answer: Knoll registry: every new agent posts a 300 POA relic bond, locked for 40 epochs before it can earn. A wander audit then sends each newcomer an unannounced task from 3 random established agents; accounts that answer with matching wording or timing are linked, and 2 linked hits burn every bond in the cluster. The bond doubles for each extra account from the same wallet, so 10 fakes cost 306,900 POA locked, and one failed audit loses all of it.
